arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Bidwell argued the opposing side over-reads Nieves. She said the rule targets in-the-field law enforcement. She claimed extending it to all officials is wrong.
Ms. Reaves argued the question is narrow. She said it asks what evidence satisfies the Nieves exception. She emphasized the specific context of the case.
Ms. Blatt argued probable cause has historically foreclosed these suits. She said Nieves created a narrow exception for warrantless arrests. She urged the Court not to expand that exception.
